campaign: Galaxy Note7 launch, recall and crisis response
objective: Launch a premium smartphone, then protect customers and recover trust after battery incidents.
businessContext: A globally promoted flagship launch encountered battery failures shortly after release, including incidents involving replacement devices.
strategy: Stop sales, coordinate recalls and refunds, investigate root causes with outside specialists, apologize and introduce a new battery-safety process.
outcomes: Samsung permanently stopped Note7 production after halting sales and exchanges.
Samsung later reported an investigation with independent specialist participation and introduced additional safety checks.
whatWorked: The later response disclosed root-cause work and operational safeguards.
Recall communication used carriers, retailers, service, social and direct contact.
whatFailed: The initial replacement program did not resolve the safety concern, forcing a second stop and permanent discontinuation.
transferConditions: Use for high-risk launches where communications, recall operations and technical remediation must be coordinated.
nonTransferConditions: Do not treat communication quality as a substitute for validated product safety.
